info.name: KAL Meet App — Auth & Kal
info.description:
Smoke collection for Supabase JWT auth (KAL-004), `POST /kal`, `GET /kal/{id}`, `GET /kal`, `PATCH /kal/{id}`, `PUT /kal/{id}/file`, the clue CRUD (`/kal/{id}/clue`), `POST /kal/participation` and `DELETE /kal/{id}`.

## Setup
1. `make up` (nginx on http://localhost:8080 by default).
2. Have Supabase local running (`supabase start`) with a user that has a `profiles` row.
3. Copy an access token from the FE / Supabase Auth (magic link session) into the collection variable `accessToken`, or into the **Local** environment. For join happy path, also set `participantAccessToken` to a **different** user's JWT (organizer joining their own KAL → 409).
4. Set `baseUrl` if you use another port (`HTTP_PORT=8081` → `http://localhost:8081`).
5. Run **POST /kal — create** then **GET /kal/{id}** so `kalId` + `inviteToken` are set; then **PATCH /kal/{id}** to smoke the update, and the **PUT /kal/{id}/file** requests in order (set → retry → replace → reused uploadId). The **Kal** folder is meant to run top to bottom: the clue requests reuse `clueId` from the clue create, and **DELETE /kal/{id} — delete** is last on purpose, because it removes the KAL everything else uses.

## Auth contract
`Authorization: Bearer <supabase_jwt>`

| Case | Status | `error` |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Missing / non-Bearer | 401 | `auth_token_missing` |
| Bad signature / iss / aud | 401 | `auth_token_invalid` |
| Expired | 401 | `auth_token_expired` |
| Valid token, no profile | 401 | `auth_profile_not_found` |
| JWKS unreachable (cold) | 503 | `auth_keys_unavailable` |

`organizerId` / `inviteToken` must **not** appear in create or PATCH bodies — organizer comes from the token; invite rotation is a later endpoint.

## PATCH /kal/{id}
Partial update of scalar fields only: `name`, `description`, `startsOn`, `endsOn`, `coverPath`. Omit = leave; `null` on nullable fields = clear. Success → `204` empty body.

## Locale and file
A KAL has **one** `locale` (string, e.g. `"ca"`), fixed at creation, and at most one pattern `file` (object, optional). Clues and files inherit the KAL locale and must not carry their own. `locales` / `files` (old contract) and `locale` / `file` on PATCH → `400 invalid_payload`.

## PUT /kal/{id}/file
Sets or replaces the KAL's pattern PDF. The body is the file itself (`fileName`, `filePath`, `fileSize`, `fileExtension`, `uploadId`, `uploadedAt`), same shape as the `file` of `POST /kal`, without `locale`. The binary is uploaded straight to Storage by the client; this only records metadata and path. Success → `204` empty body, whether it sets, replaces, or the file is already the live one (same `uploadId` → no-op). A `uploadId` already used by another `kal_files` row → `400 invalid_payload`.

## Clues
`POST /kal/{id}/clue` (201 + `{"data": {"id"}}`), `PATCH /kal/{id}/clue/{clueId}` (scalars only, 204), `DELETE /kal/{id}/clue/{clueId}` (soft delete of the clue and its meeting, 204). Unknown, deleted or foreign clue → `404 clue_not_found`.

## DELETE /kal/{id}
Soft delete of the KAL and its whole tree, one transaction, 204. Not idempotent: a second delete → 404.

request.description: Only public route. Must work without Authorization.
access_control allows only GET on `/`. Other methods need a token (and then hit the router).
Firewall deny-by-default: no Bearer → 401 `auth_token_missing`.
Malformed token → 401 `auth_token_invalid`.
Scheme must be Bearer; otherwise treated as missing token.

item.name: PUT /kal/{id}/file — retry the same file (204 no-op)

request.description: Sends the live file again (same `uploadId`, not re-minted). Idempotent: 204, nothing written, `updatedAt` does not move. Run right after the previous request.

item.name: PUT /kal/{id}/file — replace with a new file

request.description: Replaces the live file with a new one. Keeps the replaced `uploadId` in `previousFileUploadId` for the next request.

exec: pm.test('The upload id has already been used by another file.', () => {
pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql('The upload id has already been used by another file.');

request.description: Sends the `uploadId` of the file the previous request replaced (now soft-deleted). `upload_id` is the PK of `kal_files`, so an id can never be reused, not from a deleted file nor from another KAL → `400 invalid_payload`, never 500. The live file stays.

item.name: PUT /kal/{id}/file — file with its own locale (400)

request.description: The file inherits the KAL's locale; sending `locale` → `400 invalid_payload`.
Allowed: `pdf`, `csv`, `txt`. Anything else → `400 kal_file_invalid_type`.
Unknown id (or not organizer / soft-deleted) → 404 `kal_not_found`, checked before the body is validated.
Firewall deny-by-default: no Bearer → 401 `auth_token_missing`.

Firewall deny-by-default: no Bearer → 401 `auth_token_missing`.

request.description: **Run last**: it soft-deletes the KAL that every request above uses. Marks `deleted_at` on the KAL and on its whole tree (locales, files, clues, meetings, debate room) in one transaction. Success → 204.
Not idempotent: a second delete no longer finds an active KAL → 404. Run right after the previous request.
A deleted KAL no longer exists for anyone → 404.
